claims.text: The resort is on the southeastern coast of Grenada.

findings.quote: Located on the southeastern coast of Grenada, this serene retreat is both romantic and family friendly
findings.note: The official page states the southeastern coast location.

findings.quote: on the southeast side of the island, sits a quiet parish called St. David
findings.note: The review corroborates the southeast location.

claims.text: The resort is set across 38 acres of lush tropical landscape.

findings.quote: Set across 38 acres of lush tropical landscape, our 56 pool suites and 15 villas are designed for privacy and comfort.
findings.note: Exact match for the 38 acres of lush tropical landscape.

claims.text: The resort is centered around a natural saltwater lagoon.

findings.quote: Centered around a natural saltwater lagoon and spreading radially across 38 acres of undulating terrain
findings.note: The review states the resort is centered around a natural saltwater lagoon.

claims.text: Pool suites and villas are influenced by traditional Caribbean architecture, with natural materials and ocean or garden views.

findings.quote: Influenced by traditional Caribbean architecture, they offer spacious interiors, natural materials, and dramatic ocean or garden views
findings.note: Covers the Caribbean architecture influence, natural materials and ocean or garden views.

claims.text: The spa is styled like a fishing village and overlooks the lagoon.

findings.quote: starts in our fishing village style spa overlooking the lagoon.
findings.note: The spa is fishing-village style and overlooks the lagoon.

claims.text: Wellness facilities include a gym, a yoga room and a biohacking recovery lounge.

findings.quote: A full-fledged gym, yoga room, and a biohacking recovery lounge offer everything from aerial yoga to pulsed electromagnetic field therapy and sleep tracking.

claims.text: An Experience Center serves as a community hub with things to see, make and do.

findings.quote: An Experience Center and community hub bursting with fun things to see, make, and do.

claims.text: Callaloo is an all-day cafe and Seafire is a sea-front restaurant centered around a fire pit.

findings.quote: Callaloo, an all-day cafe, and Seafire, a picturesque sea-front restaurant centered around a fire pit filled with sink-in cushions
findings.note: Both restaurants are described as claimed.

claims.text: Families have the Grow With Six Senses program and a Teens' Lounge.

findings.quote: The Grow With Six Senses program and Teens’ Lounge give you a well-needed break

claims.text: The resort is about a 35-minute drive from Grenada's international airport.

findings.quote: About a 35-minute drive from Grenada’s international airport

claims.text: In the thatched beachfront suites, each room offers direct access to a private pool and the ocean shore.

findings.quote: In the thatched beachfront suites, where I stayed, each room (including the bathroom) is designed to offer direct access to a private pool and the ocean shore.

claims.text: The villas, of up to four and five bedrooms, have cliffside views, living rooms, full kitchens, lap pools and private gardens.

findings.quote: In the villas (up to 4- and 5-bedroom) with dramatic cliffside views, guests can expect even more space: living rooms, full-fledged kitchens, lap pools, and private gardens.

claims.text: The spa is designed like a village of thatched cottages connected by walkways and separated by water.

findings.quote: The spa here is designed like a village, thatched cottages are connected by walkways and separated by water bodies.

claims.text: Guests can tour local farms, including a women's farming cooperative.

findings.quote: you can arrange to tour some of their operations, including a local women's farming cooperative
findings.note: Guests can tour farm operations, including a women's cooperative.

claims.text: The resort is set away from St. George's, Grand Anse beach and the rainforest treks, each about 30 minutes by car.

findings.quote: the resort is set away from the bustle of Grenada’s capital, St. George's, the popular beaches of Grand Anse and BBC, and treks into the rainforests—and getting to any of these takes about 30 minutes by car.
findings.note: All three places are named, with about 30 minutes by car to each.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes limited nearby dining and entertainment options.
